# Greystone Guesthouse

> Greystone Guesthouse is a 3-star graded (Tourism Grading Council of South Africa) bed and breakfast at 11 Mimosa Street, Wavecrest, Jeffreys Bay 6330, Eastern Cape, South Africa. It has 8 en-suite rooms, 260 m from the beach and 300 m from the Supertubes surf break. The host is Monique. Book direct at https://book.nightsbridge.com/20319.

Key facts:

- Rooms: four deluxe rooms (1–4) with a balcony or patio and a partial sea view, from R1,200 a night for two or R700 for one. Two queen rooms (5–6) and two outside rooms (7–8, private entrance, microwave, fridge and kettle), from R1,000 for two or R650 for one. Rates are room-only; a cooked South African breakfast is available.
- Check-in 14:00–20:00, check-out 07:00–10:00. No pets, no smoking, no parties. Quiet hours 21:00–09:00.
- Free WiFi, free private on-site parking, solar power with battery backup (power and WiFi stay on during load-shedding), billiards and games room, braai area.
- Languages: English and Afrikaans.
- Airport: Chief Dawid Stuurman International Airport in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha), 80 km away, about an hour's drive.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +27 82 953 7641.
- Ratings: 8.4/10 on Booking.com (462 reviews) and 4.5/5 on TripAdvisor (135 reviews), checked October 2026.
